label: History
value: Billina was blown off a ship during a storm.
unit: Billina was blown off a ship during a storm while trapped in a wooden coop with Dorothy Gale. Washing ashore in the Land of Ev, she discovered that she could talk. She accompanied Dorothy, Tik-Tok, and the Cowardly Lion to rescue the Royal Family of Ev from the Nome King. In the Nome King's underground palace, Billina secretly discovered the secret of the transformations and saved Princess Ozma and her party by transforming them back from knick-knacks using her eggs, which are poisonous to Nomes. Afterwards, she elected to stay in the Land of Ev as Queen of the Hens, wearing a pearl necklace. She later met Dorothy again in Oz after Dorothy fell through an earthquake crack into the Underground lands.

label: History
value: The Braided Man lived alone.
unit: The Braided Man lived alone in a small cave on the sloping sides of Pyramid Mountain in the subterranean world of Midland. When Dorothy Gale, Zeb Hugson, the Wizard of Oz, Jim the Horse, and Eureka climbed up Pyramid Mountain during their journey back toward the surface, they encountered his cave. He welcomed the travelers warmly, explaining his backstory and how he came to rely entirely on brass safety pins to hold his hair and garments together. Before they departed, he gave Dorothy and her companions a supply of his rustproof brass safety pins as gifts to aid them on their journey.

label: History
value: The Cowardly Lion meets Dorothy in the yellow brick road's forest.
unit: The Cowardly Lion first meets Dorothy, the Scarecrow, and the Tin Woodman in the yellow brick road's forest, joining their quest to Emerald City in hopes that the Wizard will grant him courage. During the journey, he leaps across perilous chasms, fights off the Kalidahs, and carries his friends to safety. When sent to defeat the Wicked Witch of the West, he is captured and imprisoned, but he refuses to work for her until Dorothy frees him after destroying the witch. Upon returning to the Wizard, the Lion drinks a potion presented as courage, which restores his confidence. On the journey south to see Glinda, he slays a giant spider-like monster terrorizing an ancient forest, earning the title of King of Beasts from its animal inhabitants. He later joins Ozma's birthday celebrations and aids Dorothy and Princess Ozma in their adventures, including descending into the underground realms to rescue companions after the earthquake in California.

When sent to defeat the Wicked Witch of the West, he is captured and imprisoned, but he refuses to work for her until Dorothy frees him after destroying the witch. Upon returning to the Wizard, the Lion drinks a potion presented as courage, which restores his confidence. On the journey south to see Glinda, he slays a giant spider-like monster terrorizing an ancient forest, earning the title of King of Beasts from its animal inhabitants. He later joins Ozma's birthday celebrations and aids Dorothy and Princess Ozma in their adventures, including descending into the underground realms to rescue companions after the earthquake in California.

label: History
value: Dorothy Gale lived on a modest farm in Kansas
unit: Dorothy Gale lived on a modest farm in Kansas with her Aunt Em and Uncle Henry until a cyclone carried her house to the magical Land of Oz. Landing in the Munchkin Country, her house accidentally killed the Wicked Witch of the East. To find her way back to Kansas, Dorothy traveled the yellow brick road to the Emerald City to ask the Wizard of Oz for help, meeting the Scarecrow, the Tin Woodman, and the Cowardly Lion along the way. After vanquishing the Wicked Witch of the West and discovering the Wizard was a humbug, Glinda the Good Witch showed her that her Silver Shoes could carry her home. Later, while traveling on a ship to Australia, Dorothy was swept overboard in a storm along with a yellow hen named Billina and landed in the Land of Ev, where she rescued the Royal Family of Ev from the Nome King with the help of Princess Ozma and her old friends. Afterward, she returned to Oz before using the Magic Belt to go back to Kansas. Sometime later, Dorothy fell into a crack in the earth caused by an earthquake in California alongside her cousin Zeb, her kitten Eureka, and a cab-horse named Jim. They descended into subterranean realms, including the Land of the Mangaboos, before being rescued by Princess Ozma, who brought them to the Emerald City where Dorothy was made an official Princess of Oz before returning once more to Kansas.

To find her way back to Kansas, Dorothy traveled the yellow brick road to the Emerald City to ask the Wizard of Oz for help, meeting the Scarecrow, the Tin Woodman, and the Cowardly Lion along the way. After vanquishing the Wicked Witch of the West and discovering the Wizard was a humbug, Glinda the Good Witch showed her that her Silver Shoes could carry her home. Later, while traveling on a ship to Australia, Dorothy was swept overboard in a storm along with a yellow hen named Billina and landed in the Land of Ev, where she rescued the Royal Family of Ev from the Nome King with the help of Princess Ozma and her old friends. Afterward, she returned to Oz before using the Magic Belt to go back to Kansas. Sometime later, Dorothy fell into a crack in the earth caused by an earthquake in California alongside her cousin Zeb, her kitten Eureka, and a cab-horse named Jim. They descended into subterranean realms, including the Land of the Mangaboos, before being rescued by Princess Ozma, who brought them to the Emerald City where Dorothy was made an official Princess of Oz before returning once more to Kansas.

value: Evardo served as the royal shoemaker

label: History
value: King Evoldo of Ev sold Queen Evna to Roquat the Red, the Nome King
unit: Before the events of Ozma of Oz, King Evoldo of Ev sold his wife, Queen Evna, and their ten children—five boys and five girls—to Roquat the Red, the Nome King, in exchange for long life. The Nome King transformed Prince Evring and his family into ornamental knick-knacks and displayed them in his underground palace. When Princess Ozma of Oz, Dorothy Gale, and their companions arrived in the Nome Kingdom to rescue the royal family of Ev, Dorothy managed to guess correctly and transform Evring and his relatives back into their natural human forms. Following their restoration, Prince Evring and the rest of the royal family returned to the Land of Ev, where his eldest brother, Prince Evring's sibling Evoldo's successor, Evcred or Evring's eldest brother Evring/Evardo (Evardo), was crowned king.

label: History
value: Glinda first appears when Dorothy Gale and her companions travel south.
unit: Glinda first appears when Dorothy Gale and her companions travel south to her ruby palace seeking a way for Dorothy to return to Kansas. Glinda graciously reveals that Dorothy's Silver Shoes had the power to take her home all along, and she uses the Golden Cap's remaining wishes to send the Scarecrow, Tin Woodman, and Cowardly Lion back to their respective domains before releasing the Winged Monkeys. Later, Tip and his companions travel to Glinda's castle to seek her assistance against General Jinjur's army. Glinda investigates the lineage of the rulers of Oz and discovers that Princess Ozma, the rightful heir, was hidden away by the Wizard; she forces the witch Mombi to restore Ozma to her true form and establishes her on the throne of the Emerald City. Subsequently, Glinda remains the most powerful magical guardian of Oz, consulted during national affairs and crises.

label: History
value: The Hungry Tiger is introduced in the royal court of Oz.
unit: The Hungry Tiger is introduced in the royal court of Oz as a close companion of the Cowardly Lion. He was chosen by Princess Ozma to stand guard at her throne alongside the Lion to inspire awe in her subjects and visitors. In Ozma of Oz, he accompanies Dorothy Gale, Princess Ozma, and the Oz party to the Kingdom of Ev and subsequently into the underground realm of the Nomad King. During the quest to rescue the royal family of Ev, he offers his strength and support to the group. He continues his faithful service as one of Princess Ozma's personal guards upon returning to the Emerald City.

label: History
value: Jack Pumpkinhead was constructed by Tip.
unit: Jack Pumpkinhead was constructed by Tip in the Gillikin Country as a prank to frighten Mombi, but Mombi used her newly acquired Powder of Life to bring Jack to life instead. Fearing Mombi would turn Tip into a statue, Tip fled with Jack toward the Emerald City. Along the way, Jack addresses Tip as his father because Tip carved him. Upon reaching the Emerald City, Jack met the Scarecrow, whom he found a kindred spirit due to both being stuffed or constructed figures. After General Jinjur's Army of Revolt seized the city, Jack escaped alongside Tip, the Scarecrow, the Tin Woodman, and the Woggle-Bug, riding the Sawhorse brought to life with the remainder of the Powder of Life. After Tip was restored to his true form as Princess Ozma, Jack settled into life in Oz as a cherished member of the royal court. Later, he established a pumpkin farm where he grows replacement heads for himself when his current head begins to spoil.

label: History
value: Jim is pulling a cab driven by Zeb Hugson.
unit: Jim is pulling a cab driven by Zeb Hugson when an earthquake opens a massive fissure in the earth, swallowing Jim, Zeb, Dorothy Gale, and Eureka into the subterranean Land of the Mangaboos. Upon arriving underground, Jim discovers that he can speak, a trait shared by all animals in fairylands. He accompanies the group through various underground realms, including the Valley of Voe and the country of the Gargoyles, often defending his companions by kicking dangerous subterranean creatures. Upon reaching the Land of Oz through the assistance of the Wizard, Jim participates in a race against the Sawhorse to prove his speed, though he is ultimately defeated. Recognizing that he is too old for work, Princess Ozma places Jim in a comfortable paddock in the Emerald City where he can live out his days in leisure.

label: Personality
value: Jinjur is ambitious.
unit: Jinjur is ambitious, bold, and determined to upend the traditional social order. She possesses strong leadership skills, rallying an army of young women through sheer persuasion and cleverness. Though power-hungry during her revolt, she shows a practical and cowardly side when faced with genuine danger, such as the Scarecrow's bees or Glinda's forces. After her surrender, she accepts her defeat and settles down into a contented domestic life.

label: History
value: Jinjur first appears in the second Oz book.
unit: Jinjur first appears in the second Oz book, where she recruits and leads an Army of Revolt made up of young maidens who wish to take over the Emerald City and gain control of its jewels and wealth. Taking advantage of the city's undefended state while the Scarecrow is absent, Jinjur successfully besieges the capital, drives out the Scarecrow upon his return, and declares herself Queen of Oz. During her brief reign, she forces the men of the city to perform domestic chores while her soldiers feast on royal sweets and wear fine jewels. Her rule is challenged when Tip, the Scarecrow, the Tin Woodman, and their companions attempt to reclaim the throne, though she temporarily repels them using her cunning and guard force. Ultimately, Glinda the Good Witch marches on the Emerald City with her own army, easily surrounding Jinjur's forces. Realizing resistance is futile and terrified of Glinda's soldiers, Jinjur surrenders the city. After Princess Ozma is restored as the rightful ruler, Jinjur is pardoned and returns to her home, eventually settling down to a quiet life of domesticity.

unit: Jinjur first appears in the second Oz book, where she recruits and leads an Army of Revolt made up of young maidens who wish to take over the Emerald City and gain control of its jewels and wealth. Taking advantage of the city's undefended state while the Scarecrow is absent, Jinjur successfully besieges the capital, drives out the Scarecrow upon his return, and declares herself Queen of Oz. During her brief reign, she forces the men of the city to perform domestic chores while her soldiers feast on royal sweets and wear fine jewels. Her rule is challenged when Tip, the Scarecrow, the Tin Woodman, and their companions attempt to reclaim the throne, though she temporarily repels them using her cunning and guard force. Ultimately, Glinda the Good Witch marches on the Emerald City with her own army, easily surrounding Jinjur's forces. Realizing resistance is futile and terrified of Glinda's soldiers, Jinjur surrenders the city. After Princess Ozma is restored as the rightful ruler, Jinjur is pardoned and returns to her home, eventually settling down to a quiet life of domesticity.

label: History
value: Mombi conspired with the Wizard of Oz
unit: Years before the events of the series, Mombi conspired with the Wizard of Oz to keep the realm's true ruler, Princess Ozma, hidden. Mombi transformed the baby princess into a young boy named Tip and raised him harshly in the Gillikin Country. When Tip attempted to scare her with a wooden jack-lantern named Jack Pumpkinhead, Mombi brought Jack to life using the Powder of Life she bought from Dr. Pipt. Threatening to turn Tip into a marble statue, Mombi prompted Tip to flee with Jack, eventually leading to General Jinjur's revolt against the Scarecrow. Mombi allied with General Jinjur to help maintain control of the Emerald City using her magic. When Glinda the Good arrived to restore the rightful ruler of Oz, Mombi attempted to escape by shape-shifting into various animals, including a rose, a griffin, and a stream of water. Glinda captured her and forced her to reveal the truth about Tip's identity. Glinda then removed Mombi's magical powers and turned her into a stone statue to ensure she could never cause harm again.

label: History
value: The Nome King struck a bargain with the wicked King of Ev
unit: Before the events of his grand conflict with Oz, the Nome King struck a bargain with the wicked King of Ev, buying the Queen of Ev and her ten children and transforming them into decorative ornaments in his palace. When Princess Ozma, Dorothy Gale, and their companions traveled to the Nome Kingdom to rescue the Ev royal family, Roquat tricked them into a guessing game that transformed most of the rescue party into knick-knacks as well. Billina the hen discovered the secret to the transformations and also exposed Roquat's ultimate vulnerability to eggs. Terrified by Billina dropping eggs, the Nome King was defeated, and Ozma reclaimed the Royal Family of Ev along with Roquat's powerful Magic Belt. Deprived of his magic belt and thoroughly humiliated, the Nome King harbors a deep hatred for Ozma and Dorothy and plots vengeance to reclaim his stolen power.

When Princess Ozma, Dorothy Gale, and their companions traveled to the Nome Kingdom to rescue the Ev royal family, Roquat tricked them into a guessing game that transformed most of the rescue party into knick-knacks as well. Billina the hen discovered the secret to the transformations and also exposed Roquat's ultimate vulnerability to eggs. Terrified by Billina dropping eggs, the Nome King was defeated, and Ozma reclaimed the Royal Family of Ev along with Roquat's powerful Magic Belt. Deprived of his magic belt and thoroughly humiliated, the Nome King harbors a deep hatred for Ozma and Dorothy and plots vengeance to reclaim his stolen power.

label: History
value: Princess Ozma was hid away by the Wizard of Oz as an infant.
unit: As an infant, Princess Ozma was hid away by the Wizard of Oz and given to the witch Mombi, who transformed her into a boy named Tip so that her true identity would remain unknown. Growing up as Tip, she knew nothing of her royal heritage and lived a simple life under Mombi's cruel guardianship. Tip eventually ran away after creating the Sawhorse using Mombi's Powder of Life, assembling companions like the Woggle-Bug and Jack Pumpkinhead along the way. Upon arriving in the Emerald City, Tip helped defend the city and eventually sought the aid of Glinda the Good. Glinda discovered Mombi's secret and forced the witch to restore Tip to her true form as Princess Ozma. Ozma assumed her rightful place upon the throne of the Emerald City as the ruler of all Oz. Later, using her Magic Picture, she observed Dorothy Gale trapped under the earth and brought her, Zeb, the Wizard, and Jim the Cab-Horse safely to the Emerald City.

label: History
value: The Saw-Horse was created by Tip.
unit: The Saw-Horse was created by Tip in the Gillikin Country as a makeshift horse and brought to life using Mombi's magic Powder of Life. He carried Tip and Jack Pumpkinhead on their journey toward the Emerald City, though his ears were initially lost in an accident. During the rebellion of General Jinjur, he helped Tip and his companions escape by being bound together with other materials to form the Gump, though he later returned to his individual wooden form. Glinda the Good Sorceress rewarded his loyalty by fitting his wooden legs with plates of solid gold to keep them from wearing away. Following Princess Ozma's restoration to the throne of Oz, the Saw-Horse became an official royal steed. In later adventures, he accompanied Dorothy Gale, Zeb, the Wizard of Oz, and their friends through the underground realms back to the Emerald City.

Following Princess Ozma's restoration to the throne of Oz, the Saw-Horse became an official royal steed. In later adventures, he accompanied Dorothy Gale, Zeb, the Wizard of Oz, and their friends through the underground realms back to the Emerald City.

label: History
value: The Scarecrow was created in the Munchkin Country.
unit: The Scarecrow was created in the Munchkin Country to guard a cornfield, but he felt useless when the crows realized he was stuffed with straw. When Dorothy Gale passed by on her way to the Emerald City, he joined her journey in hopes that the Wonderful Wizard of Oz would grant him brains. Along the way, he repeatedly devised clever plans to save Dorothy, the Tin Woodman, and the Cowardly Lion from various perils, such as crossing deadly chasms and escaping the Kalidahs. Upon reaching the Wizard, he was sent to destroy the Wicked Witch of the West, during which he was disassembled by Winged Monkeys before being restored by his companions. The Wizard eventually gave him a simulated brain made of bran, pins, and needles, which fully satisfied the Scarecrow's confidence. Before leaving in his balloon, the Wizard appointed the Scarecrow as the new ruler of the Emerald City. He ruled until General Jinjur and her Army of Revolt deposed him, forcing him to seek help from his friend Tip and the Tin Woodman; together, they eventually restored Princess Ozma to the throne. Afterward, the Scarecrow remained a beloved royal advisor and friend to the rulers of Oz, later reuniting with Dorothy during her underground adventures and assisting in the defeat of the Gargoyles and the fake Wizard's trials.

label: History
value: Tiktok was created by Smith & Tinkell.
unit: Tiktok was created by the inventors Smith & Tinkell in the Kingdom of Ev and was later purchased by the King of Ev. The King locked him in a mountain cave, where he remained frozen for many years until Dorothy Gale discovered him and wound up his clockwork mechanisms. Once revived, Tiktok declared himself Dorothy's servant and accompanied her, Billina, and Princess Ozma on their quest to rescue the Royal Family of Ev from the Nome King. During the expedition, he fought bravely against the Wheeler people and assisted in navigating the underground realm of the Nomes. Though his clockwork occasionally ran down at critical moments, he was brought back to the Emerald City as a honored subject of Princess Ozma. In subsequent adventures, he remains a valued and loyal citizen of Oz.

label: History
value: The Tin Woodman was oiled by Dorothy Gale
unit: After being oiled and freed by Dorothy Gale and the Scarecrow, the Tin Woodman joined their journey to the Emerald City to ask the Wizard of Oz for a heart. Along the way, he helped defeat numerous threats using his axe and befriended the Cowardly Lion. Sent by the Wizard to destroy the Wicked Witch of the West, he was dismantled by the Witch's Winkie slaves, but his tin body was later repaired by the Winkies after her defeat. In gratitude for liberating them, the Winkies invited him to become their ruler, a title he accepted as Emperor after receiving a silk-and-sawdust heart from the Wizard. Later, he accompanied Dorothy on her quest to find Glinda the Good Witch and helped defend the group against various monsters. When Dorothy returned to Oz via the earthquake, he reunited with her at the Emerald City, participated in the Wizard's trial, and helped celebrate Ozma's court before returning to his domain.

label: History
value: Tip grows up under the guardianship of Mombi.
unit: Tip grows up under the harsh guardianship of the witch Mombi in the Gillikin Country of Oz. To prank Mombi, Tip carves a man out of wood with a pumpkin head, whom Mombi unexpectedly brings to life using the magic Powder of Life. When Mombi threatens to transform Tip into a marble statue, Tip steals the Powder of Life and escapes with Jack Pumpkinhead. On their journey to the Emerald City, Tip creates the Sawhorse and brings it to life as a mount. Arriving at the Emerald City, they become embroiled in General Jinjur's rebellion, forcing Tip and his growing company of unusual friends to flee. Together with the Scarecrow, the Tin Woodman, and the Woggle-Bug, Tip constructs the Gump to fly across Oz for help. After consulting Glinda the Good Witch, it is revealed that Mombi transformed the baby Princess Ozma into Tip. Glinda forces Mombi to reverse the enchantment, restoring Tip to her true form as Princess Ozma, the rightful ruler of Oz.

unit: Tip grows up under the harsh guardianship of the witch Mombi in the Gillikin Country of Oz. To prank Mombi, Tip carves a man out of wood with a pumpkin head, whom Mombi unexpectedly brings to life using the magic Powder of Life. When Mombi threatens to transform Tip into a marble statue, Tip steals the Powder of Life and escapes with Jack Pumpkinhead. On their journey to the Emerald City, Tip creates the Sawhorse and brings it to life as a mount. Arriving at the Emerald City, they become embroiled in General Jinjur's rebellion, forcing Tip and his growing company of unusual friends to flee. Together with the Scarecrow, the Tin Woodman, and the Woggle-Bug, Tip constructs the Gump to fly across Oz for help. After consulting Glinda the Good Witch, it is revealed that Mombi transformed the baby Princess Ozma into Tip. Glinda forces Mombi to reverse the enchantment, restoring Tip to her true form as Princess Ozma, the rightful ruler of Oz.

label: History
value: Toto was Dorothy's pet dog
unit: Toto was Dorothy's pet dog in Kansas and kept her happy on the prairie. When a cyclone carried Dorothy's farmhouse away, Toto was swept along with her to the Land of Oz. He accompanied Dorothy on her journey down the yellow brick road to the Emerald City, helping reveal the true identity of the Wonderful Wizard of Oz by accidentally knocking over the screen hiding him. After returning to Kansas with Dorothy via the Golden Cap and Glinda's help, Toto lived on the farm until Dorothy took him on a trip to San Francisco. During an earthquake, Toto, Dorothy, her cousin Zeb, and Jim the horse fell through a fissure in the earth into the underground realm of the Mangaboos. Toto traveled through various subterranean lands, including the Valley of Voe and the Den of the Dragonettes, before being rescued by the Wizard of Oz and brought up to the Emerald City once more. During a trial in Oz after Eureka the kitten was accused of eating the Nine Tiny Piglets, Toto helped keep order before returning safely back to Kansas with Dorothy.

He accompanied Dorothy on her journey down the yellow brick road to the Emerald City, helping reveal the true identity of the Wonderful Wizard of Oz by accidentally knocking over the screen hiding him. After returning to Kansas with Dorothy via the Golden Cap and Glinda's help, Toto lived on the farm until Dorothy took him on a trip to San Francisco. During an earthquake, Toto, Dorothy, her cousin Zeb, and Jim the horse fell through a fissure in the earth into the underground realm of the Mangaboos. Toto traveled through various subterranean lands, including the Valley of Voe and the Den of the Dragonettes, before being rescued by the Wizard of Oz and brought up to the Emerald City once more. During a trial in Oz after Eureka the kitten was accused of eating the Nine Tiny Piglets, Toto helped keep order before returning safely back to Kansas with Dorothy.

label: History
value: Uncle Henry lived with Aunt Em in a small one-room farmhouse in Kansas.
unit: Uncle Henry lived with his wife, Aunt Em, and orphaned niece, Dorothy, in a small one-room farmhouse in Kansas. When a powerful cyclone struck their farm, Henry ran to tend to the livestock while Dorothy was carried away inside the house. After the cyclone passed, he and Aunt Em were left behind to rebuild their life, believing Dorothy was lost until she miraculously returned. Some time later, when Henry fell ill from overwork, his doctor advised him to take a relaxing trip. He took Dorothy on a sea voyage to Australia, but during a fierce storm at sea, they were separated when Dorothy and a kitten fell overboard into the water, eventually finding their way to the land of Ev and Oz.

label: History
value: The Wicked Witch of the West ruled the Winkie Country in the western quarter of Oz.
unit: The Wicked Witch of the West ruled the Winkie Country in the western quarter of Oz, enslaving the native Winkies. When Dorothy Gale and her companions were sent by the Wizard of Oz to destroy her, the Witch spotted them with her single eye. She sent wolves, crows, and bees to destroy them, but Dorothy's companions repelled each assault. She then used the magical Golden Cap for the third and final time to command the Winged Monkeys, who destroyed the Scarecrow and Tin Woodman, captured the Cowardly Lion, and brought Dorothy to her castle. The Witch forced Dorothy to work as a servant and tried to starve the Lion into submission. Spotting the magical Silver Shoes on Dorothy's feet, the Witch tricked Dorothy into tripping so she could steal one shoe. Enraged, Dorothy threw a bucket of water over the Witch, causing her to melt completely into a brown, shapeless mass. Following her death, the Winkies were freed from her tyranny and appointed the Tin Woodman as their new ruler.

label: Personality
value: The Wizard originally was a humbug
unit: Though originally a humbug and imposter who relied on trickery and ventriloquism, the Wizard possesses a kind heart and a quick wit. He regrets deceiving the people of Oz, though he originally did so out of fear of the Wicked Witches. He is resourceful, clever, and deeply loyal to Dorothy and Princess Ozma. Despite his lack of real magical powers, he uses stage magic and science to solve problems and assist his friends.

label: History
value: The Wizard unified the central region.
unit: After arriving in Oz by runaway balloon, the Wizard unified the central region and built the Emerald City, forcing the populace to wear green-tinted glasses. Fearing the Wicked Witches of the East and West, he hid in his palace and ruled through illusions and ventriloquism. When Dorothy Gale arrived seeking a way home, he demanded she destroy the Wicked Witch of the West before he would help her. Dorothy's dog Toto eventually knocked over a screen in his throne room, revealing him as a humbug. After granting symbolic gifts to the Scarecrow, Tin Woodman, and Cowardly Lion, he attempted to return to Kansas with Dorothy in a hot-air balloon, but accidentally left without her. He returned to circus life in America until an earthquake swallowed his balloon in California, sending him down into the subterranean realm of the Mangaboos where he reencountered Dorothy. He helped Dorothy, Zeb, and Jim the horse navigate dangerous underground kingdoms, including the valley of Voe and the Den of the Dragonettes. Upon reaching the surface in Oz, Princess Ozma welcomed him back, inviting him to stay permanently in the Emerald City to learn real magic.

Fearing the Wicked Witches of the East and West, he hid in his palace and ruled through illusions and ventriloquism. When Dorothy Gale arrived seeking a way home, he demanded she destroy the Wicked Witch of the West before he would help her. Dorothy's dog Toto eventually knocked over a screen in his throne room, revealing him as a humbug. After granting symbolic gifts to the Scarecrow, Tin Woodman, and Cowardly Lion, he attempted to return to Kansas with Dorothy in a hot-air balloon, but accidentally left without her. He returned to circus life in America until an earthquake swallowed his balloon in California, sending him down into the subterranean realm of the Mangaboos where he reencountered Dorothy. He helped Dorothy, Zeb, and Jim the horse navigate dangerous underground kingdoms, including the valley of Voe and the Den of the Dragonettes. Upon reaching the surface in Oz, Princess Ozma welcomed him back, inviting him to stay permanently in the Emerald City to learn real magic.

label: History
value: The Woggle-Bug spent his early life crawling about a country schoolhouse.
unit: The Woggle-Bug spent his early life crawling about a country schoolhouse, absorbing all the geography, history, and science taught by the schoolmaster, Professor Nowitall. One day, the schoolmaster caught him and placed him in a magic lantern to project his enlarged image onto a screen. Taking advantage of his new giant size, the Woggle-Bug escaped through a window to seek his fortune in Oz. He encountered Tip, Jack Pumpkinhead, the Sawhorse, and the Scarecrow, joining their party as they fled General Jinjur's Army of Revolt. After Glinda restored Princess Ozma to the throne of Oz, the Woggle-Bug was appointed to found and manage the Royal College of Art and Athletics in the Emerald City. In subsequent years, he remained a respected scholar in Oz, known for his eccentric lectures, grand fashion sense, and fondness for puns.
